questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Highway Planning, Historical Development & Route Alignment
questions.text: Explain Highway Classification according to Nepal Road Standard (NRS 2070): National Highways, Feeder Roads, District Roads, and Urban Roads. Explain the engineering survey stages for highway alignment: Map Study, Reconnaissance Survey, Preliminary Survey, and Final Location & Detailed Survey.

Define Stopping Sight Distance (SSD) and Overtaking Sight Distance (OSD). Derive formulas: $\text{SSD} = v t + \frac{v^2}{2g(f \pm 0.01n)}$ (PIEV theory) and $\text{OSD} = d_1 + d_2 + d_3$. Calculate SSD for a design speed of $80\,\text{km/h}$ on a $3\%$ downward gradient with reaction time $2.5\,\text{s}$ and longitudinal friction coefficient $f = 0.35$.

What is Super-Elevation ($e$)? Derive the formula for super-elevation: $e + f = \frac{v^2}{g R} = \frac{V^2}{127 R}$. Explain the IRC / NRS design procedure for super-elevation: (1) Design for $75\%$ design speed neglecting friction ($e = \frac{V^2}{225 R}$), (2) Check if $e \le e_{max} = 7\%$, (3) If $e > 0.07$, calculate lateral friction $f$, and (4) If $f > 0.15$, restrict speed. Design super-elevation for a horizontal curve of radius $300\,\text{m}$ for design speed $80\,\text{km/h}$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Highway Planning, Historical Development & Route Alignment
questions.text: Explain Transition Curves (Euler's Spiral / Clothoid). Derive the length of transition curve based on: (a) Rate of change of centrifugal acceleration ($L_s = \frac{v^3}{C R}$), (b) Rate of introduction of super-elevation ($L_s = e N W$), and (c) Empirical formulas.

Explain California Bearing Ratio (CBR) Test procedure for highway subgrade soil. Describe testing for road aggregates: Los Angeles Abrasion Test, Aggregate Impact Value (AIV), Flakiness and Elongation Index. Describe Bitumen tests: Penetration test, Ductility test, Softening Point (Ring and Ball test), and Flash and Fire point tests.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Flexible & Rigid Pavement Structural Design
questions.text: Compare Flexible Pavement vs. Rigid Pavement in terms of load distribution mechanism, stress propagation, design life, and maintenance cost. Explain Equivalent Single Axle Load (ESAL) and design a flexible pavement using IRC:37 CBR method given traffic growth rate $7.5\%$ and design life 15 years.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Flexible & Rigid Pavement Structural Design
questions.text: Explain Westergaard's Theory for Rigid Pavement stresses: (a) Wheel load stresses at Corner, Edge, and Interior regions, (b) Temperature warping stresses, and (c) Frictional stresses. Explain expansion, contraction, and longitudinal joints with dowel bars and tie bars.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Highway Drainage & Surface Runoff Management
questions.text: Explain Surface and Subsurface Drainage systems for highways (Camber, Side drains, Catchwater drains, Chutes, Sub-drains). Explain Hill Road alignment challenges: Hairpin Bends (Design criteria according to NRS), Landslides prevention, Retaining walls, Breast walls, and Revetment walls.
